input.content: Idempotency/recovery record looked up by aggregate key instead of operation ID (P1). Pattern: a retry-recovery lookup scans records by entity (e.g. workspace) rather than the caller-supplied operation/idempotency ID. Consequence: any fresh operation ID for the same entity matches the earlier completed record, skips the side effect and still returns success under the new ID (silent no-op); ID reuse across entities can overwrite audit records. Check: idempotency state must be keyed by the operation ID; a fresh ID must perform a fresh operation; the response should come from the matched record's own receipt. Add a test: completed op-1 then op-2 on the same entity with different values must apply op-2.
